name: Solitaire Arcade
summary:
Solitaire Arcade is a collection of classic card games, including Klondike Solitaire, FreeCell, Spider, TriPeaks, Pyramid, Golf Solitaire, Hearts, Spades, 500, Gin Rummy, Crazy Eights and Thirteen.

The collection includes both single-player solitaire games and card games played against computer opponents. Individual games offer different modes, rules and gameplay features, including hints, undo controls and scoring systems where applicable.
